method: Bridge the 2026-09-06 long-term operating scenarios through the announced KRW 3tn rights offering. Convert prior per-share scenario values to total equity using 46.290951m shares; add scenario value assigned to the rights-funded acquisition/capex package; divide by pro-forma 48.560951m shares.
warning: This isolates the financing/deployment event. It is not a standalone DCF of PolyPeptide and does not claim that acquisition price equals intrinsic value.

deployment_value_logic.bear: 0.5x gross proceeds: integration/capex destroys part of invested value or earns sub-cost-of-capital returns.
deployment_value_logic.base: 1.0x gross proceeds: new capital roughly earns its opportunity cost; transaction is approximately value-neutral before future upside.
deployment_value_logic.bull: 1.5x gross proceeds: peptide/geographic/capacity synergies create material value above invested capital.

market_expectation_interpretation: At the reference price, base-case margin of safety is absent. The stock does not mechanically require the internal bull case, but current price already discounts meaningful duration, utilization and capital-allocation success.
next_model_required: After final rights terms and PolyPeptide closing, build a full pro-forma model incorporating purchase-price allocation, target debt, target revenue/FCF, integration capex, consolidated share count, working capital and incremental ROIC.
